verdict_reason: The draft-only MDM species check is correct and wired into isReviewRefused, but the refusal leaves no log naming the species, the array normaliser is duplicated, and the existing JSDoc holds rationale.

todos.issue: speciesCardErrors refuses a draft because reference data (MDM) no longer lists a saved species, and nothing logs which species and codes caused it. The declaration controller only logs the generic DECLARATION_REFUSAL.reviewRefused, so support cannot tell an MDM withdrawal from an incomplete card during an incident.
todos.fix: Must: a submit refused for unlisted species logs once at warn with the journey id and each unlisted code and Latin name. One way: in speciesCardErrors, when unlisted is non-empty, log { journeyId: journey.journeyId, unlisted } at warn before returning the error (thread a logger in, or return the unlisted list so isReviewRefused can log it with request.logger).

todos.issue: chosenSpecies (line 18) re-writes the [value ?? []].flat() normaliser that check-answers already owns as toArray in view-model/rows/value-text.js:10 (used by view-model/applicability.js for the same answers.commodityLines). documentScanStatuses (line 43) sits beside it with a third copy.
todos.fix: Must: one function owns normalising an answer to an array, and refusal.js calls it. One way: import toArray from './view-model/rows/value-text.js' and use toArray(answers.commodityLines) and toArray(answers.documents).

todos.issue: The JSDoc on documentScanCardErrors carries rationale ('A REJECTED scan is permanent... a PENDING one is transient') and describes the caller's situation ('when the trader has just been refused for it') rather than the includePending contract.
todos.fix: Must: the doc comment states only the exported contract (what it returns for REJECTED and for PENDING with includePending true/false); the rationale lives in the repo docs or the behaviour spec. One way: '@param {{includePending?: boolean}} options - include an error for a PENDING scan (default true). @returns the documents card error: someRejected for any REJECTED scan, else someStillScanning for a PENDING one when includePending, else {}'.
